fact.statement: The husk of a spent wisp crumbles to ash and scatters.
A warding charm blunts injuries but is less effective on higher-ranked travelers.
Bronze-ranked travelers shrug off minor injuries almost instantly.
Ember shards are common components for rune-craft and charm-making.
Lesser glimmer coins are essential for powering lower-tier charms.
Lesser glimmer coins are produced by defeating lesser wisps.
Defeating lesser wisps yields exactly ten glimmer coins each time.
Defeating lesser wisps also produces one wisp core each time.
Glimmer wells produce glimmer coins by condensing ambient leyline energy.
Storm intensity scales directly with ambient heat.
A ward charge above five triggers an overload state.
Casting a rite from a rune tablet consumes stamina and can lead to exhaustion.
Leyline resonance sometimes hums at dusk for reasons no scholar has explained.
